About our school

MAT Senior Secondary School is a Day Secondary School in Juba providing quality education for Senior 1 to Senior 4 (Science & Arts). With dedicated and qualified teachers and intensive focus on Mock and National Examination preparation, we are committed to nurturing disciplined and academically excellent learners.

“
The nation is because of education

Our motto

Our vision

To build a generation of educated, disciplined, and responsible citizens who will transform South Sudan through knowledge and skills.

Core values

  • Discipline
  • Hard Work
  • Integrity
  • Excellence
  • Patriotism

Classes

Our students follow a full secondary curriculum.

Secondary 1 & 2

English, maths, chemistry, biology, geography, history, accounting, citizenship, agriculture and languages.

Secondary 3

Subject choices, practical lessons and study skills.

Secondary 4

Final exam preparation, career guidance and university advice.

Admission requirements

To apply to Mat Senior Secondary School, please bring the following to the school office.

  • Completed application form from the school office
  • Previous school report or transfer letter
  • Primary school certificate (for Senior 1 entry)
  • Copy of birth certificate or other proof of age
  • Recent passport-size photographs
  • Parent or guardian name and phone number
